description: This file contains transformation utilities for converting between A2A message formats and OpenAI message formats, including handling streaming events and creating various message events such as task initiation, status updates, and artifact updates. It also defines a context class for managing streaming state and includes methods for transforming responses and chunks between formats.

classes.name: A2AStreamingContext
classes.description: Holds the state and context information for A2A streaming sessions, tracking task ID, context ID, input message, accumulated text, and flags for emissions.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,str]] a2a_message_to_openai_messages( a2a_message: Dict[str, Any], )
methods.description: Converts an A2A message to one or more OpenAI-format messages, mapping roles and extracting text parts.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] openai_response_to_a2a_response( response: Any, request_id: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Transforms a LiteLLM ModelResponse into an A2A SendMessageResponse format, extracting content and setting up message parts.

methods.name: str _get_timestamp()
methods.description: Returns the current UTC timestamp in ISO format, used for status update events.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_task_event( ctx: A2AStreamingContext, )
methods.description: Generates the initial 'task' event signaling task submission in A2A streaming.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_status_update_event( ctx: A2AStreamingContext, state: str, final: bool = False, message_text: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Creates a status update event for streaming indicating progress or completion.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_artifact_update_event( ctx: A2AStreamingContext, text: str, )
methods.description: Constructs an artifact update event containing the content artifact.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] openai_chunk_to_a2a_chunk( chunk: Any, request_id: Optional[str] = None, is_final: bool = False, )
methods.description: Legacy method that converts a streaming chunk from LiteLLM to an A2A streaming format, deprecated in favor of event-based methods.

ctags.signature: ( ctx: A2AStreamingContext, state: str, final: bool = False, message_text: Optional[str] = None, )
